rationale: v1 RMSF label conflated local flexibility with terminal global swing: alpha-syn case window read 21.8 A absolute (tail diffusion), controls 8-10 A - the comparison measures where the free end dangles, not local transient structure

label_v2.name: dihedral_circular_stability
label_v2.definition: per-residue circular mean resultant length R of phi and psi across ensemble models (same ensembles as v1); local score = mean(R_phi,R_psi); higher = more conformationally stable = transient structure
label_v2.applies_to: NMR ensembles only (nmr_v2 / nmr_fetched); AFDB single models have no ensemble and keep pLDDT (downgraded)
label_v2.direction: H1-v2 predicts case windows HIGHER stability than matched controls

reporting_rules.both_labels_reported: v1 RMSF and v2 dihedral stability each under their own closed rules
reporting_rules.no_gate_shopping: a direction flip between labels is reported as a label-dependence finding, not cherry-picked
reporting_rules.primary_interpretation: v2 is the local-structure-faithful label; v1 is retained as the displacement-scale view
